obligations.text: No verb of this product publishes, releases or uploads anything; a release is started only by the owner pushing a signed version tag, and the workflow it starts is repository delivery, not product behaviour.

Every archive is built by cargo-dist at an exact version for aarch64 and x86_64 on macOS and Linux, from the tagged commit with the committed lockfile, and every action the workflow uses is pinned by commit digest.

Each archive carries a CycloneDX SBOM from the committed lockfile and a keyless build-provenance attestation naming it as subject; a release with an SBOM of zero components, or an archive without an attestation, is not published.

A dry run of the release workflow on a test tag produces four archives, a shell installer, a formula, four non-empty SBOMs and four attestations that verify with gh attestation verify, and publishes nothing.

record.summary: Specifies how this repository delivers its own binaries, under the F-02 narrowing of 2026-10-20: a tag the owner pushes builds macOS and Linux archives for aarch64 and x86_64 with cargo-dist at an exact version, a shell installer and a Homebrew formula, a CycloneDX SBOM per archive that refuses to ship empty, and a keyless build-provenance attestation per archive. It adds no verb, and no verb in this corpus publishes. The binary's name, the Homebrew tap and the version scheme are the owner's decisions.
record.title: Releasing this repository's binaries is repository delivery: cargo-dist archives, installers, SBOM and build provenance
